items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: What year was it that you played Billy Berg's?

ctx.x: -- Billy Berg's to try out something and it went over so big, so they did another couple of weeks. So that went over big, so they said, "Well, we'll try it out on the road." So they went out on the road with the thing and it got to be big and so they called it Louis Armstrong's All-Stars.
What year was it that you played Billy Berg's?
